name: generate_spread_from_text
description: Generates a publication-grade vector architectural spread from a text description using Swiss modular grids, constructive detailing standards, and the 10 Archetypes.

projectId.description: Project ID to attach the spread to.

prompt.description: Prompt describing the architectural plate or narrative act (e.g. 'Act 4: 1:20 Wall Section with rainscreen cladding, lime-hemp insulation, and dimension strings').

archetype.description: Layout archetype to structure the spread.
